description: Angular renderer for json-render: renders AI-generated JSON specs, constrained to a catalog of your components, as standalone Angular components with signals, zoneless. Streams specs as RFC 6902 patches (injectUIStream, injectChatUI). Includes ngx-json-render-material, a ready Angular Material catalog, and an MCP App view (ngx-json-render/mcp).
rules: Install with `npm install ngx-json-render @json-render/core zod`; Angular 19 or later (the Material catalog needs 20 or later).
Catalog components are standalone components with no inputs: read props with `injectRenderContext().props()` and render children with `<jr-children />`.
Define catalogs with `schema` from `ngx-json-render/schema`, which has no Angular dependency, so server code can import the same catalog file.
In a spec, `visible`, `on`, `repeat`, `slots` and `watch` sit on the element, never inside `props`.
Stream specs with `injectUIStream`, or `injectChatUI` for chat replies that mix prose and specs; do not hand-filter half-streamed elements, give the registry entry a `fallback` instead.
For a ready-made component set, use `ngx-json-render-material` (`materialRegistry`, `materialCatalog.prompt()`) instead of writing a catalog first.
